summary.text: Chris Burdick is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 93 since January 2021 and is running for re-election in 2026.
He previously served for seven years as Supervisor of the Town of Bedford.

paragraphs.text: Chris Burdick earned a B.A. in economics and history from the University of California at Berkeley, a master's in international studies from the Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies and a J.D. from Seton Hall Law School.
Before becoming Bedford town supervisor, he was an attorney at Stewart Title Insurance Company of New York, where he was chief underwriting counsel.
He and his wife, Illyria, have been married for 39 years and have three adult children and two granddaughters.
Burdick joined the Assembly in January 2021 after seven years as Bedford town supervisor.

He sits on the Banks, Correction, Environmental Conservation, Housing, People with Disabilities, and Veterans' Affairs committees and chairs the Subcommittee on Employment Opportunities for People with Disabilities.
In 2023 City & State named him one of the state's most prolific legislators, with 14 bills passed that session.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said road conditions and rising utility rates are the two most important issues facing the 93rd Assembly District, and that he has been a party in utility rate cases involving ConEd and NYSEG.
